notes.title: October 23rd Update Notes:
notes.notes:
Increased the zoom level for game scenes.
Added audio hints; when there are unfound cats within the current game window, a cat's meow will serve as an audio hint.
Fixed some known issues.

notes.title: Cats Spotter game officially released.
notes.notes: This is my first game developed independently by myself. Due to my oversight, the game has many shortcomings, which I will address and adjust as soon as possible. Since I am working on this alone, the speed of fixing and resolving issues will be slower. Thank you once again.
